posts.old: Imagine waking up and having a brand-new set of permanent teeth in just one day. This dream can now become a reality with the innovative dental procedure known as “teeth-in-a-day.” If you’re curious about how this process works and whether it’s right for you, keep reading.
posts.new: For suitable patients, a full arch of fixed temporary teeth can be fitted on the same day as implant surgery, a treatment often called “teeth in a day”. This article explains how it works, who it may suit and the factors that affect the result.

posts.old: is a cutting-edge dental procedure that allows patients to receive a full set of new teeth in a single day. Unlike traditional dental implant treatments that can take several months to complete, teeth in a day offers a quicker and more convenient solution for full mouth restorations.
posts.new: is a treatment in which a fixed temporary bridge is attached to the implants on the day of surgery. The final bridge is made and fitted once the implants have integrated with the bone, generally three to six months later.

Benefits of Teeth in a Day
posts.new: Possible Benefits of Teeth in a Day

posts.old: 1. Immediate Results
posts.new: 1. Fixed Temporary Teeth From the Day of Surgery

posts.old: One of the most significant advantages of the same day teeth procedure is the immediate results it offers. Instead of waiting months for your final restoration, you can enjoy a brand-new smile with renewed function right away.
posts.new: For suitable patients, a fixed temporary bridge is attached on the day of surgery, so there is no period without teeth while waiting for the final bridge. A soft diet is needed while the implants heal.

posts.old: 2. Reduced Healing Period
posts.new: 2. Fewer Surgical Procedures

posts.old: Because teeth in a day eliminates the need for multiple surgeries and lengthy healing periods, patients can return to their normal activities much sooner. This means less time spent recovering and more time enjoying life with your new set of teeth.
posts.new: Because extractions and implant placement are often done in the same operation, and bone grafting can sometimes be avoided, some patients need fewer surgical procedures. Recovery varies from person to person, and your surgeon will explain what to expect in your case.

posts.old: 3. Enhanced Confidence
posts.new: 3. Function and Appearance

posts.old: Missing teeth can take a toll on your self-esteem and confidence. With teeth in a day, you can regain your smile and your confidence in just one day, allowing you to feel great about your appearance once again.
posts.new: Missing teeth can affect eating, speaking and how people feel about their smile. A fixed bridge may help with these, although individual results vary.

posts.old: Teeth in a day is an excellent option for individuals who are missing one or more teeth and are looking for a permanent solution for tooth replacement.
posts.new: Teeth in a day may be an option for people who are missing most or all of their teeth in one or both jaws, or whose remaining teeth cannot be saved. A consultation and 3D scan show whether it suits you.

posts.old: teeth in a day may be the perfect solution for you.
posts.new: teeth in a day may be worth discussing with your surgeon.

posts.old: For busy individuals who don’t have time for multiple dental appointments, teeth in a day offers a convenient and time-saving alternative.
posts.new: Teeth in a day can mean fewer surgical appointments, although reviews and the final bridge still need several visits.

posts.old: Conclusion: A New Smile in Just One Day is Possible.
posts.new: Conclusion

posts.old: The teeth in a day technology has revolutionised the field of dentistry, offering a fast, convenient, and permanent solution for tooth replacement. Whether you’re missing one tooth or an entire arch, this innovative procedure can provide you with a brand-new smile in just one day. If you’re tired of dealing with missing teeth, pain or uncomfortable dentures, schedule a consultation with your dental practitioner to see if teeth in a day is right for you.
posts.new: Teeth in a day is one way to replace a full arch of teeth with fixed implant-supported teeth, with a temporary bridge fitted on the day of surgery for suitable patients. Whether it suits you depends on your bone, your general health and your goals. Talk to your dentist, or arrange a consultation with an oral and maxillofacial surgeon, to find out whether it is right for you.

posts.old: What is the Best Age to Remove Your Wisdom Teeth?
posts.new: When Should Wisdom Teeth Be Removed?

posts.old: Removing the wisdom teeth, particularly, if any pain has been noticed, should be done as early as possible. Having such problematic teeth removed between ages of 17 and 25 is recommended because the roots of the wisdom teeth have not formed totally, and the bone surrounding the tooth is softer making the extraction process easier.
posts.new: Not every wisdom tooth needs to be removed. When a wisdom tooth is causing problems, or is likely to, removal between the ages of 17 and 25 is often simpler, because the roots may not be fully formed and the surrounding bone is softer. Your surgeon will advise whether and when removal is recommended for you.

posts.old: Delaying wisdom teeth removal is often regretted when not occurred in the teenage years.
posts.new: If you have been advised that a wisdom tooth may need to come out, wisdom teeth removal is usually easier to plan before problems develop.
